newsitem.title: UK: Tin at fresh low in AM ring, copper spreads busy.
newsitem.headline: Tin at fresh low in AM ring, copper spreads busy.

text.p: TIN - Dips to a fresh 2-1/3 low of $5,395 under light general selling. Failure to hold current levels likely to prompt sell-off towards $5,300.
COPPER - Three months untraded in early ring. Spreads active, cash to threes backwardation at $140/$145, versus $130 earlier.
NICKEL - Small gain on Norilsk fire. OTHERS - Slow
